content_json: {"title":"How It Played","body":"A theme built on lived experience was always going to reward the person with the best story, and Mara arrived with a Rose Bowl upset, a tailgate, the Wiltern, and a best friend named Sarah Z — The Sounds' \"Rock n Roll\" took gold at 11 with zero downvotes before most ballots were even cast. Below her the field bunched tight: Screeching Weasel and Andrew Bird deadlocked at 7, BP's Jerrys Pizza basement riff tying Queen0Reno's spinning Janus horns, with the tiebreak landing exactly where a season that just watched \"Cannonball\" lose one on a cascade would least want to see it. Amyl and The Sniffers pulled 6 and the round's widest split — six positives against two downvotes — proving Tommy's bogans win converts and enemies in equal measure.","note":"The bottom told the real story. Layous checked his comment box 'by mistake,' openly fishing for a −1, and Jon, jac and monicac1217 all obliged a man who asked. Sarah's Zach Bryan took a Queen0Reno autopsy and a three-way downvote to land at 1. And Phil's Eagles sank under four. Eleven songs, a theme that demanded you show up with a memory — the ones who told it all the way through finished on top, and the ones who leaned on a studio remaster and a vibe got the boot. Season Three opens exactly like the last two: the matriarchy on top, the knife compulsory, and someone already filing a grievance."}
